title: Melee at the Food Court
content: This morning I woke up from having a dream, but it disappeared too quickly. Then, I remembered the guy holding a demonstration in the bakery - he was making small crème tarts for everyone. I came in the door and took a scoop of oatmeal or hummus with a wooden spoon, and proceeded to top it off with whipped cream and smacked it down on the glass counter near the finished tarts, all while staring at the chef dead in his face. Angered by my comedic interruption, the chef asked “What the hell is this guy doing?” I said “Oh go on, I just wanted a little sample…” The crowd of onlookers moved back as the angered chef vaulted from behind the counter, attacking me. I was ready as if I was just there to cause trouble, but I didn’t count on his students backing him up when I got the upper hand. I was getting pummeled from all sides and decided this stunt didn’t turn out too well. I teleported from the middle of the group to a buffet lounge in the mall that was facing the large windows. The sun was going down and a beautiful cinematic sunset of magenta, violet, and golden tones mixed in with the streaks of clouds. I piled my plate with some food and a white cardboard bento box - taking my tray over to an empty table so I could watch the sky change colors.
